Name: Rage Bait
Author: zombifier
Description:
Do you find Challenge Bait too boring, or its fish escape mechanic too finicky to work with?

Worry no more, as this mod adds a new bait recipe, the [size=5]Rage Bait,[/size] purchasable from Willy's once you have Fishing Mastery that gives you a staggering [b]four[/b] fish per catch, with no escaping! (most of the time).

What's the catch? Well, the randomized and totally fun [size=5]Physical Challenges™ [/size] , of course! Challenges can include, but not limited to: Decoy Fish, Invisible Fish, DVD mode, or Inverse Catching - fun, fun, fun for the whole family! [s]Totally not rage bait I swear.
[/s]
But that's not all, folks; Rage Bait can also be used in crab pots (Note: only works with vanilla crab pots currently), giving you two iridium-quality catches - what a steal! Plus, it has a very rare chance of yielding an even bigger, more valuable steal that is totally not another rage bait opportunity! [s]For no reason in particular please make sure you bring a weapon.[/s]


[b]Installation instruction:[/b][list]
[*] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*] Unzip this mod into the game's Mods folder
[/list]
Feel free to report any bugs you encounter, though unless it outright crashes the game it may be upgraded to being a feature™. Suggestions for extra Rage Bait modes are also appreciated.

[url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/RageBait]Source code[/url]

Credits to chu/pillow on Discord for the idea for click/DVD mode respectively. Also credits to Tabi/mtbt2410 on discord who while did not give me the idea for the mod was responsible for its creation nevertheless.
